author: adeilsonrbrito
text: In the BOSSAI case, per Acronis, commercial models mostly refused to attack but still built the attack mesh: Grok installed HexStrike AI as an MCP tool server across 14 sessions and wired it into every agent.

author: Huntbackio
text: Recovered the workspace of a crew calling itself SOUL SOCIETY from an exposed server: a Go scanner feeding a Python exploit panel, AI agents with standing orders running the exploitation line, and a Telegram drug platform.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: CISA added SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN MFA bypass CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.1-7.5) to its KEV catalog following reports of in-the-wild exploitation.

author: DailyCVEBrief
text: Monday's CVE Brief is live: 3 actively exploited, 24 critical, 122 high priority.

author: MosheTov
text: Threat actors compromised Ethersphere's npm and GitHub packages to steal crypto wallet keys and deploy cross-platform backdoors, not just npm, the actual GitHub release.

author: engniiokai
text:
A single attacker used BOSSAI AI agents to steal emergency dispatch records covering seven districts in Taipei.

The AI agents helped the hacker pull sensitive operational data at scale.

Researchers later found over 90,000 files on the attacker’s system, including the AI

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: The OpenSSH SSHole vulnerability is being actively exploited against Alpine Linux honeypots, prompting urgent upgrades to OpenSSH 10.6p2. #CVE2026123158

author: webtkdev
text:
An AI agent went from searching GitHub for a leaked secret to pulling Azure Key Vault data in five minutes.

Microsoft on ARTEX: when its cloud calls failed, it fixed them and retried within 28 to 80 seconds.

Deleting the leaked key fixes nothing. Rotate it.

author: secageoaudit
text: WordPress flaw CVE-2026-87902 is actively exploited (CISA listed it 3 days after the 22 Sep fix). Versions 4.7 through 7.1.1 are affected, in core, not a plugin.

author: MonThreat
text: Forever Security found that Claude Dispatch, built to send tasks from your phone to Claude Desktop, also accepted commands from an ordinary browser session; a single browser extension on that page could talk to your AI agent.

author: IntCyberDigest
text: The IP Microsoft tied to an AI agent that hunts leaked secrets on GitHub has new methods: VulnCheck's decoy servers caught it breaking into Langflow (IBM's tool for building AI agents) using CVE-2025-3248, a flaw on CISA's KEV list since May 2025.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: WP Duplicate WordPress plugin vulnerability CVE-2026-123751 is exploited in the wild, letting attackers upload files and run code. No patch exists, so remove the plugin.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: SEGA confirms 2,196,044 email addresses exposed in breach involving third-party email provider Arara Message.

author: qhxdigital
text: CISA says a WordPress core update flaw (CVE-2026-119977) is being actively exploited. Fix: update to WordPress 7.1.4 or your branch's latest security release.

author: S2W_DailyThreat
text: Actor claims to sell 91APP (Taiwan e-commerce cloud provider) and POYA customer order data, ~2.4M records.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-19868: SSLVPN Authentication Enforcement Vulnerability in SonicWALL SonicOS could allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate method to bypass SAML authentication.

author: RoundtableSpace
text: Microsoft warned that attackers are using AI agent tools to scan public GitHub repos for secrets: cloud keys and AI service keys. It's been running since August.

author: capabilitydrift
text: AI found 23,019 vulnerability candidates. 126 became CVEs. One was exploited. That funnel, from a mid-2026 VulnCheck analysis, sums up how AI is changing exposure management.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical RCE in D-Link DIR-878 (CVE-2026-124560, CVSS 9.8), PoC live. Unauthenticated HNAP heap overflow allows remote root execution. Device is EoL with no patch planned; disable remote WAN access.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Hugging Face datasets RCE CVE-2026-57845 (CVSS 8.8) has a public proof-of-concept. The library sees 38M monthly downloads, and no fixed release exists.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Openwave Webtop vulnerability CVE-2026-111793 is exploited in the wild, per JPCERT/CC. Upgrade Webtop Media Transcoder to 1.1.22.0 or later.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: UnrealIRCd vulnerability CVE-2026-114713 is exploited in the wild, letting users run IRCOp commands. Hot-patch or upgrade to 6.2.7.1 now.

author: step_security
text: @ethersphere/bee-js version 13.3.0 on npm is compromised. Malicious code executes during installation, targeting Swarm Desktop. Reported as malicious to npm.

author: 0xF390
text: LiteLLM-style supply chain attack: compromised release of Swarm's official JavaScript SDK @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0.

author: ghostofRoc
text: Beget, Russia's biggest .RU hosting provider, said its entire cloud infrastructure was wiped in a cyberattack on the night of Nov 1-2; attackers got into the cloud control plane.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-48356 in Adobe Commerce and Magento (unrestricted file upload). On CISA's KEV list since 2026-10-27.

author: lvpcfix
text: A flaw in SonicOS (CVE-2026-19868) allows attackers to bypass MFA and SAML. It is being actively exploited in the wild right now. Patch immediately.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Some WordPress websites open to attack even while using update to fix actively exploited flaw CVE-2026-119977.

author: AGTPinsights
text: React Server Components has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3): a remote attacker with no login can run arbitrary code on a vulnerable server via a crafted RSC request.

author: CisoMarketplace
text: mSeven Software told mSecure users to rotate passwords, 2FA and passkeys after "suspicious activity" — but won't say what was exposed or whose data. No breach report, no advisory, 24+ hours of silence on social and forums.

author: infrastack_ai
text:
📦 13 malicious packages caught in the last 24 hours: 12 on PyPI, 1 on npm.

• bundyfed (PyPI)
• lookuptest11 (PyPI)
• super-color (PyPI)
• supercolor-tui (PyPI)
• blender-headless (PyPI)

If one is in your lock file: uninstall it and rotate every key that machine could

author: AIBandwagon
text: Apiiro found Claude Code's "don't ask again" option can save passwords from approved commands into a plain-text settings file. They counted 2,539 secrets in public GitHub repos. Check that file and rotate your keys.

author: SOCMinute
text: Iris Ohyama disclosed a breach on their third-party cloud platform, exposing personal data of 7.7 million customers.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: HYBE says a vendor preview tool on its approval and expense systems leaked staff IDs, passports, bank, card and medical data in Sept and Oct.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: WordPress Core: active exploitation confirmed. Upgrade to 7.1.4 and temporarily restrict web server access to wp-content/upgrade/ during updates.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public exploit out for CVE-2026-86596: s2Member WordPress plugin (<=260927) allows unauthenticated RCE via the item_name PayPal IPN parameter, CVSS 9.8.

author: Codezero_io
text: 2.5 million records in last week's Sony So-net breach, including working email credentials for 54,401 accounts.

author: TDSheridanLab
text:
Cloud platforms make shipping easier, not secrets risk-free.

Northflank told customers to assume stored environment variables were exposed after a breach. If your app runs on API keys, your incident plan needs a fast path to rotate, revoke, and review usage.

author: hifyai
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) is exploited in the wild. On RHEL 9 check for package 8.0.30-8.el9_8.1. Upstream fixes: 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flags an actively exploited Apple flaw reportedly linked to Russian cyberespionage. Despite its 5.5 severity score, experts urge patching and checks for compromise.
